title: Sales Tax Calculator: Add Tax, Remove Tax or Find the Rate
description: Free sales tax calculator: add tax to a price, work backward from a total to the price before tax, or find the tax rate from two amounts. Rounded to the cent.
lead: How much is the total with tax? What did that item cost before tax? What rate was I charged? Pick a question, enter your numbers and get the answer to the cent, with the formula behind it.
